fact: The 2025 policy states that ZISPIS operationalizes a unified national register of beneficiaries for key social protection interventions, rolled out to 116 districts starting with the Social Cash Transfer module and with the 1,000 Days SCT pilot integrated, but that ZISPIS has not been fully operationalized and the sector remains fragmented with MIS developed in silos.
title: 2025 National Social Protection Policy
publisher: Republic of Zambia, Ministry of Community Development and Social Services
